title: Unified Renderer-Neutral Store Abstraction
description: Introduce abstract Store<TSnapshot> in @framework/core, controller-owned store registry, Component extends Store, renderer useStore hooks, sketchpad ComposeKitStore + local store, puzzle play controllers provide domain stores. Full unification, no backwards compat.
summary: Playground renderer now uses controller-owned stores end-to-end: usePuzzle3dPlaySnapshot binds via useControllerStore(PUZZLE_3D_PLAY_STORE_ID); TopologyStoreProvider resolves domain store from TopologyStoreBridge on controller.getStore(TOPOLOGY_PLAY_STORE_ID). Exported useStore, useControllerStore, Store from playground renderer. Exported TopologyStoreBridge from puzzle 5d play. All prior store abstraction work intact. Tests: playground renderer 13/13, sketchpad js 4/4.
